title: A Group of Flamingos Has a Special Name
short_teaser: Even groups of animals can have creative names.
story: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance. Many collective animal names were created because people noticed unique behaviors or appearances. Even groups of animals can have creative names. Words give shape to ideas that might otherwise remain difficult to hold. A phrase, name, or story can become a doorway into memory, meaning, identity, and a new way of seeing. The lasting importance is simple: language itself is full of creativity.
impact: Language itself is full of creativity. The words we choose can preserve meaning, change perspective, and help an idea travel from one person to another. This matters because the lesson is transferable. It can help someone recognize a pattern, make a more thoughtful choice, or see possibility where they previously saw only a problem.
spark_application: What ordinary thing could you describe in a more creative way? Capture one phrase, word, or sentence that stays with you. Add a note about why it matters and how you might use it. Afterward, save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
